preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in S)
preconditions.description: Every character in S is either '0' or '1'.
The length of S is strictly between 1 and 10^5 (exclusive).

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i + 1, len(S) + 1) if S[i:j].count('1') > S[i:j].count('0'))
postconditions.description: The returned integer is the count of all substrings of S where the number of '1's exceeds the number of '0's. A substring is defined as a contiguous sequence of characters S[i..j-1] for 0 ≤ i < j ≤ len(S).
